metadata.description: Safe Keys, a Claude Code mod that keeps the API keys you paste out of the conversation, the transcript, the screen and the model while your tools still use them.

plugins.name: safe-keys
plugins.description: Paste an API key into Claude Code and it becomes a name everywhere: the transcript on disk, the screen, the model. Bash and PowerShell get it as a real environment variable, other tools get the value at the moment they run, and anything a tool prints back is cleaned before the model reads it.
